goal: Clarify responsibilities of jobs query/detail/artifacts/events/manifest, stop mixing db/config/view aggregation in route layer
acceptance: Form executable split direction, subsequent implementation no longer needs to decide whether route or service handles aggregation
notes: Confirmed first cut should prioritize query/detail read paths, not touching job_runner first.

goal: Converge assembly logic of list/detail/artifacts/events/manifest into services/jobs/presentation, prevent route from directly accessing db/config/view mapper
acceptance: routes/jobs/query.rs and routes/jobs/mod.rs only keep HTTP parameter parsing and ApiResponse wrapping; aggregation logic moved to service layer
notes: Added presentation service, query/detail/artifacts/events/manifest now assembled uniformly through this layer.

task: Reduce route direct dependencies on underlying resources
goal: Make query/download/control routes no longer get business-level loaders from routes/job_helpers, but uniformly use the boundary exposed by services/jobs
acceptance: routes/job_helpers only keep HTTP helpers like request_base_url, stream_file, submission view; business loading functions exit helper layer
notes: Currently job_helpers have significantly thinned, remaining work concentrated on create route.

task: Split create route business orchestration responsibilities
goal: Make routes/jobs/create.rs no longer simultaneously do request parsing, upload storage, DB save, job creation, synchronous waiting, and bundle download orchestration
acceptance: create route only handles HTTP adapter; creation, synchronous waiting, bundle generation moved to application service
notes: PDF upload persistence, OCR upload creation, translate bundle synchronous waiting and zip construction sunk to services/jobs/creation.rs; create route now only keeps multipart/JSON parsing and response stream encapsulation.

goal: Clear the boundaries of snapshot assembly, persistence, spawn, and command construction, avoid a single service spanning domain assembly and infra orchestration
acceptance: job_factory no longer simultaneously knows build snapshot, persist_job, spawn_job, command construction; at least split out independent assembly and execution boundaries
notes: job_factory split into explicit build_job_snapshot and start_job_execution phases; services/jobs/creation.rs now calls assembly-first then start, no longer relies on build_and_start_job black box.

goal: Reduce direct coupling of routes/services to config/db/downloads_lock/canceled_jobs/job_slots, gradually converge from infra bag to clear capability interfaces
acceptance: After adding narrower service/repository boundaries, new code no longer directly passes entire AppState
notes: Narrowed upload storage paths in services/jobs/query, services/jobs/presentation, services/artifacts, services/glossaries, job_events, and creation/uploads to `&Db + &Path` or config local field combinations; job_runner/commands and job_factory snapshot assembly narrowed to `&AppConfig`; creation layer split out pure assembly helper and bundle context; job_events/process_runner/lifecycle added narrow resource helpers based on `Db + data_root + output_root`. Remaining AppState kept at route entry and runtime coordination layer intentionally.

task: Move aggregation read logic out of models/view.rs
goal: Let view model return to DTO/mapper role, move file reading, failure diagnosis, summary aggregation to service layer
acceptance: Production paths no longer depend on file reading and failure diagnosis aggregation in models/view.rs; legacy helpers only kept for test paths
notes: jobs presentation now constructs JobDetailView/JobListItemView itself, handling normalization/glossary/invocation and failure diagnosis at service layer; corresponding old aggregation helpers in models/view.rs downgraded to `#[cfg(test)]`, not included in production build.

goal: Add targeted and regression tests for boundaries after splitting query presentation, create orchestration, and job_factory
acceptance: New tests lock in thinner routes, service aggregation boundaries, and prevent regression of old interface behavior
notes: Completed presentation/query targeted verification and fixed legacy tests in job_factory still asserting on old `--file-path`; added creation layer success/failure path tests covering full pipeline snapshot assembly, render artifact source, ocr source_url, translate missing upload, render missing artifact source, and non-PDF upload rejection. Further complete tests needed for process runner and view-model finalization paths.

goal: Define boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces for current and future refactors in doc/rust_api and READMEs to prevent outdated documentation from misleading developers
acceptance: Docs clearly explain responsibilities of route, service, job_runner, and view model, consistent with code
notes: Synced API_SPEC and doc/rust_api README; added 09-Collaborative Development Conventions" doc defining responsibility boundaries for route/service/job_factory/job_runner
